title: [WIP] Fix issues in action run step
body:
- [x] Understand the problem - build failing due to incompatible `supports` property in InMemoryDriver
- [x] Review the updated `DriverCapabilitiesSchema` to understand all required fields
- [x] Update the `InMemoryDriver.supports` property to include all required capabilities
- [x] Address code review feedback - set capabilities to match actual implementation
- [x] Test the build to ensure it passes
- [x] Run security checks - no issues found

## Summary
Fixed GitHub Actions build failure caused by missing query operation capabilities in the `InMemoryDriver.supports` property. The `DriverCapabilitiesSchema` was recently expanded to include granular query capabilities (`queryFilters`, `queryAggregations`, `querySorting`, `queryPagination`, `queryWindowFunctions`, `querySubqueries`), but the driver implementation was not updated to match.

Updated the driver to declare all required capabilities, setting values based on the actual implementation:
- `queryPagination: true` - Basic pagination is implemented
- `jsonFields: true`, `arrayFields: true` - Native JS support
- All other query capabilities set to `false` as they are not yet implemented

Build now passes successfully ✅
